actions.alias: Find the room's lights and sensors
Work out what the room needs

variables.too_bright:
{% set threshold = lux_threshold | float(0) %} {{ threshold > 0 and not manual_run
   and room_lux_entities | length > 0
   and room_lux_entities | map('states') | map('float', 0)
       | select('le', threshold) | list | count == 0 }}
variables.lux_blocked_entities: {{ resolved_entities | reject('is_state', 'on') | list if too_bright else [] }}
variables.reachable_entities:
{{ resolved_entities | reject('is_state', 'unavailable') | reject('is_state', 'unknown')
   | reject('in', hands_off_entities) | list }}
variables.room_occupancy_entities:
{% set sensors = (room_entities | select('match', '^binary_sensor\\.')
     | select('is_state_attr', 'device_class', 'occupancy') | list
   + room_entities | select('match', '^binary_sensor\\.')
     | select('is_state_attr', 'device_class', 'motion') | list)
   | reject('is_state', ['unavailable', 'unknown']) | list %}
{{ sensors if use_area_sensors
   else sensors | select('in', named_entities) | list }}
variables.occupied:
{# The room is in use if anything it runs is already on. #} {{ resolved_entities | reject('in', hands_off_entities)
   | select('is_state', 'on') | list | count > 0 }}
variables.allow_turn_on:
{{ manual_run
   or (trigger is defined and trigger.id is defined and trigger.id == 'motion_on')
   or occupied
   or (trigger is defined and trigger.id is defined and trigger.id == 'lux_dark'
       and not too_bright
       and room_occupancy_entities | length > 0 and not occupancy_clear_for_wait) }}
variables.entities_still_on:
{{ resolved_entities | select('is_state', 'on')
   | reject('in', hands_off_entities) | reject('in', idle_entities) | list }}
variables.phase_scene: {% set m = {'Morning': morning_scene, 'Day': day_scene, 'Evening': evening_scene, 'Night': night_scene} %} {{ m.get(phase) }}
variables.scene_recheck_due: {{ not (trigger is defined and trigger.id is defined and trigger.id == 'tick') }}
